description: Fork of exp496 (ReLU gate). gate_mode=relu_norm: g=ReLU(ts+b[n_tables,K])/sum(ReLU(ts+b)) -- sparsemax-style SPARSE+NORMALIZED. Fixes exp496's common-mode (debug: unnorm ReLU summed to ~40/table, 16x output scale -> +0.12 vs softmax). Keeps ReLU sparsity (only well-matching rows fire -> hardenable) AND Σ=1 normalization (like softmax, no common-mode). Q: match/beat softmax (exp493 1.4806) AND harden better (sparse already)? vs exp475 1.4962. relu_bias per-table no-wd.
